title: Network Engineer L1
description:
Looking for **Branch Network engineer\-L1 Level**

Experience: 1\.5 to 3 yrs

Location: Mahape(work from office and rotational shifts)

Looking for immediate joiners to who can join on or before 5th October 2026\.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Branch \& Data Center Rollouts \& Equipment Deployment**

● Plan, execute, and monitor end\-to\-end infrastructure rollouts for new branch setups, relocations, and data center deployments.

● Oversee the physical installation, mounting, and cabling of network hardware (routers, switches, firewalls, access points, and UPS units).

● Conduct site readiness audits, maintain up\-to\-date rack elevation diagrams, and ensure standardized configuration standards across all locations.

**2\. Telecom Link Procurement \& Lifecycle Management**

● Manage the complete lifecycle of primary and backup telecom links (MPLS, ILL, Broadband, 4G/5G, point\-to\-point) across all branches.

● Initiate feasibility studies, raise bandwidth requisitions, track link delivery timelines, and oversee end\-to\-end circuit commissioning.

● Monitor ISP SLAs (latency, packet loss, uptime), manage circuit renewals, perform periodic bandwidth utilization reviews, and handle link decommissioning.

**3\. Level 1 Network Support \& Operations**

● Serve as the first point of escalation for branch network outages, link failures, and equipment malfunctions.

● Monitor network performance using centralized NMS tools, create incident tickets, and perform initial troubleshooting on routing, switching, and Wi\-Fi issues.

● Coordinate with L2/L3 network engineers and ISP desk teams to achieve swift Mean Time to Restore (MTTR).

**4\. Vendor Management \& Panel Onboarding**

● Lead the onboarding process for network hardware suppliers, system integrators, and telecom service providers onto the corporate vendor panel.

● Evaluate vendor SLAs, draft Scope of Work (SOW) documents, and review contractual deliverables for network installation and hardware maintenance.

● Conduct quarterly vendor performance reviews and resolve service delivery bottlenecks.

**5\. Financial \& Billing Management**

● Oversee the processing, verification, and timely approval of telecom link invoices, hardware purchase orders, and AMC/RMA bills.

● Track monthly operational expenditure (OpEx) against the IT network budget to eliminate billing errors, penalty overcharges, or service disconnections.

● Maintain an itemized ledger of active circuit IDs, billing cycles, and recurring contract costs across all branches.

**6\. Certifications:Basic network certification required (CCNA preferred or Network\+).**

**Shortlisted candidates interview will be scheduled offline only.**

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7\-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team. **Competencies:**



Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control \- Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

**Job Title:** F5 Load Balancer \- Level 3 Engineer


### **Job Summary**



We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. This role is crucial to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications delivered through F5 technologies. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.


### **Responsibilities**


* **F5 Load Balancer Administration:**
* Implementation and manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM, ASM, APM modules).
* Develop and implement F5 profiles, rules and policies to meet business requirements.
* Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot F5 infrastructure to ensure uptime and reliability.
* Analyze logs and performance data to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Implement health checks and failover strategies to ensure high availability of applications.


**Firewall Administration:**


* Network Security
* Manage Checkpoint/Cisco ASA firewalls
* Provide support for firewalls


**Troubleshooting:**


* Serve as the Level 3 (L3\) escalation point for resolving complex network and application\-related issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, traffic flow, and application performance issues involving F5 products.


**Collaboration:**


* Work closely with network engineers and application teams to ensure alignment on load balancing requirements.
* Collaborate on security compliance audits and assessments related to load balancing and traffic management.


**Security:**


* Implement security measures such as SSL offloading, web application firewalls (WAF), and DDoS protection on F5 devices.
* Stay updated on the latest security threats and ensure configurations are optimized to mitigate risks.


**Documentation:**


* Create and maintain documentation for F5 configurations, processes, and network architecture.
* Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to junior engineers or team members.


**Automation \& Optimization:**


* Automate routine tasks using F5 iControl REST API and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
* Propose improvements and optimization strategies for load balancing services.

### **Requirements**


* **Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

### **Experience**


* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience with F5 load balancers (BIG\-IP LTM, GTM, ASM, APM). Checkpoint or ASA firewalls.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing advanced load balancing solutions.
* Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, DNS, and related technologies.

### **Skills**


* Proficiency in writing and debugging F5 iRules.
* Strong understanding of application traffic flows and troubleshooting techniques.
* Knowledge of network security principles, SSL certificates, and encryption methodologies. Firewall management
* Familiarity with other load balancers, firewalls, and web proxies is a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based load balancing solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins for infrastructure automation.
* **Soft Skills:**
* Flexible to work according to requirements
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
* Strong communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or collaboratively.
* **Certifications:**
* F5 Certified BIG\-IP Administrator (F5\-CA) or higher certification is preferred.
* CCNA/CCNP or other relevant network certifications are good to have.

### **Required Skills**


* network security
* f5 load balancer
* checkpoint
* firewall
* ipsec vpn
* f5 big\-ip
* f5 irules
